description: This file defines a PHP class UserSearchFilterParams in the OrangeHRM project, extending a base FilterParams class. It models the parameters for filtering user searches within the admin plugin, including fields like username, status, role ID, employee number, and password presence, and specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: UserSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering user search queries in the admin plugin, encapsulating filter criteria such as username, status, role, employee number, and password presence, and managing sort field options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of UserSearchFilterParams, setting the default sort field to 'u.userName'.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status filter (boolean or null).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status filter to the specified boolean value.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username filter (string or null).

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username filter to the specified string.

methods.name: getUserRoleId
methods.description: Returns the user role ID filter (integer or null).

methods.name: setUserRoleId
methods.description: Sets the user role ID filter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter (integer or null).

methods.name: hasPassword
methods.description: Returns whether the user has a password set (boolean or null).
